Fleet Feet is your local running store, offering personalized outfitting, training programs and gear backed by 50 years of expertise. Shop Online Experience the 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon through New York City’s iconic streets. From Brooklyn to the Manhattan Bridge, through Times Square, and finishing in Central Park! This race combines unforgettable views, city energy, and the joy of running alongside thousands of other runners! Join the SFA's United Airlines NYC Half Marathon Team Today! When you participate in the marathon, you are choosing to join hundreds of others who want to make a difference for sarcoma patients and their families. Funds raised through our marathon race team help drive innovative research for sarcoma. Race details are subject to change. Please consult the race website to confirm all event information.
